title: Observability vendor scorecard
content:
## Criteria
- Metrics at our cardinality
- Tracing UX
- Log retention
- Price

## Scores
| Vendor | Metrics | Tracing | Logs | Price |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Datadog | 5 | 4 | 4 | 2 |
| Grafana Cloud | 4 | 3 | 5 | 4 |
| Honeycomb | 2 | 5 | 3 | 3 |

Final decision is recorded in the #infra thread.
